name: Little Factory
description:
Three stages, one growing packing queue.

Does another station help when the same team must staff it?

Starting assumptions
• One hour of variable order arrivals; no warm-up period.
• Machining, inspection and packing each need their own team.
• Staff are occupied for the full service duration. Material stock and transport are not modeled.

Synthetic teaching models. Timings, demand and staffing are illustrative; layout does not add travel time.
